parameters.prompt: The exact upright horned yak demon king in the reference gives ONE commanding summon in place. From the resting pose it raises its right arm high and sweeps it forward and down, pointing ahead with the open hand as if ordering troops to attack, the left fist clenched at its side and the horned head held high, holds this commanding pointing pose for a moment, then lowers the arm and calmly returns to the exact original standing pose and holds it. Both feet stay planted. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Exactly two arms and two legs. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. Keep the same three-quarter left view, curved horns, dark shaggy mane, bracers, ornate belt, red kilt and tail. No walking, turning, jumping, extra limbs, weapon, glow, energy, magic effects, smoke, mist, dust, rocks, cracks, particles, shadow or text. Motion beats: raise the arm over the first second, point forward around one and a half seconds and hold to three seconds, then recover and hold the original pose.
